Author: shridhar
Message:
fix: centralize WhatsApp account fetch with decryption

Replace all inline DB queries for WhatsApp accounts with
resolveWhatsAppAccount which handles both lookup and decryption.

Previously, most code paths fetched accounts from the database
but never called decryptAccountSecrets, causing "Cannot parse
access token" errors when encryption is enabled.

Also fixes org-scoping in SLA processor queries that previously
had no organization_id filter.

Author: Shridhar Patil
Message:
Feat/multi org management (#145)

* feat: Add multi-organization management (backend + frontend)

Backend: Add org CRUD, member management, org switching via JWT,
user-organization associations, and permission-based access control.

Frontend: Add org member management page, org switcher for multi-org
users, invitation-based registration flow, and supporting API/store
changes.

* test: Add e2e and integration tests for multi-org management

- Update e2e API helper with org member CRUD and register with org_id
- Rewrite register e2e tests for invitation-based registration flow
- Update org-switch e2e tests to use create org + register flow
- Add members page e2e tests (UI and API)
- Add Go integration tests for all org member handlers

* perf: Replace Preload with JOIN query in ListOrganizationMembers

Eliminates 2 separate IN queries (users, custom_roles) that scaled
poorly with member count. Now uses a single JOIN query.

* refactor: Merge Members into Users page, fix multi-org user flows

- ListUsers now queries via user_organizations JOIN to show all users
  with access to the org (not just home-org users)
- ListUsers uses org-specific role from user_organizations instead of
  users.role_id
- ListOrganizationMembers now has pagination and search support
- AddOrganizationMember accepts email as alternative to user_id
- Register allows existing users to join a new org by verifying their
  password and adding them as a member
- Move invite link and add-existing-user dialog to Users page
- Remove Members nav item and route (redundant with Users page)

* fix: Improve error message when existing user registers with wrong password

* refactor: Remove unused Members page, add Create Organization to switcher

- Delete MembersView.vue (merged into Users page)
- Remove unused API methods (listMembers, updateMemberRole, removeMember)
- Remove unused members i18n keys, move invite link keys to users section
- Remove nav.members i18n key
- Add "Create Organization" button to org switcher (permission-gated)

* fix: Update tests for multi-org user_organizations table

- Add UserOrganization to test DB migrations and cleanup tables
- Update CreateTestUser to auto-create user_organizations entry
- Fix Register tests to use organization_id instead of organization_name
- Remove duplicate manual UserOrganization creation in org member tests
- Add test for existing user joining new org via registration

* fix: Rename path param from user_id to member_id to avoid auth context collision

The route params {user_id} in /organizations/members/{user_id} collided
with the auth middleware's user_id context key, causing permission checks
to run against the target user instead of the authenticated user.

* fix: Update e2e tests for multi-org UI changes

- Remove members UI tests (page merged into users)
- Fix register tests for RouterLink strict mode violation
- Add tests for Copy Invite Link and Add Existing User
- Fix Add User button selector after new buttons were added

* fix: Replace refresh icon with plus icon for create organization

* test: Add e2e tests for create organization via sidebar plus button

* fix: Use selected org ID for invite link when org is switched

* fix: Multi-org member management and permissions

- SwitchOrg now loads role + permissions into response (fixes
  permissions not applying after org switch)
- GetCurrentUser reads org-specific role from JWT context
- ListUsers, GetUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser all use
  user_organizations JOIN to support cross-org members
- Members can only have their role updated (not full edit/delete)
- DeleteUser removes members from org instead of deleting account
- Add is_member flag to user response and show Member badge in UI
- Differentiate actions: members get "Update Role" + "Remove Member"
- Add X-Organization-ID to CORS allowed headers for production

* fix: Restore soft-deleted users when recreating with same email

When a user is deleted (soft delete) and recreated with the same email,
the unique index on email blocks the INSERT. Now checks for soft-deleted
users with Unscoped() and restores them with updated details instead.

* docs: Add multi-org management and organization API documentation

- Update authentication docs with organization_id register flow and
  switch-org endpoint
- Update users docs with is_member field, cross-org member behavior,
  and list my organizations endpoint
- Add new organizations API reference (CRUD, member management, settings)
- Update roles & permissions with multi-org access section replacing
  super-admin-only org switching
- Add organizations to API overview and sidebar navigation

Author: Shridhar Patil
Message:
Testsuit (#93)

* add more tests

* test: Expand backend test coverage from ~270 to 838 test functions

Add comprehensive tests across handlers (contacts, users, templates,
chatbot, custom actions, canned responses, API keys, analytics, SLA,
webhooks management, chatbot processor) and packages (whatsapp API,
websocket, database). Covers CRUD operations, cross-org isolation,
validation errors, business logic, and edge cases.

* fix: Resolve CI test failures and lint error

- Add Redis to chatbot processor test app to fix nil pointer in
  getKeywordRulesCached
- Filter pub/sub messages by campaign ID to fix race condition in
  queue stats subscriber test
- Remove unused withWSHub helper to fix golangci-lint unused error

* fix: Resolve chatbot processor test CI failures

- Add mock WhatsApp client to processor test app to fix nil pointer in
  startFlow/sendAndSaveTextMessage
- Work around GORM default:true on bool fields: use explicit UPDATE to
  set is_enabled=false since GORM skips zero-value bools on INSERT

* fix: Save flows to DB before creating sessions with FK references

TestCompleteFlow_UpdatesSession and TestExitFlow_UpdatesSession created
sessions with CurrentFlowID pointing to flows that weren't saved to the
database, causing silent FK constraint failures.

* refactor: Include Redis in newTestApp, remove newTestAppWithRedis

Consolidate into a single test app builder that always sets up Redis,
since cache functions require it. All handler tests now use newTestApp.

* fix: Remove unused withRedis helper and redis import

* fix: Match AssertErrorResponse to fastglue envelope format, add missing models to migrations

- APIEnvelope now matches fastglue's actual format: message is a
  top-level field, not nested under an error object
- Add Catalog, CatalogProduct, and CannedResponse models to test
  DB migrations and cleanup tables

* fix: Resolve CI test failures across multiple packages

- queue: Remove t.Parallel() from stream tests that share a single
  Redis stream, preventing cross-test interference
- custom_actions: Fix GORM default:true bool issue in createTestCustomAction
  by explicitly updating is_active to false after INSERT
- chatbot: Fix UpdateChatbotSettings to explicitly set default:true bool
  columns to false after INSERT when requested
- contacts: Preserve original limit in GetMessages pagination response
  instead of returning the adjusted query limit
- templates: Add sample values to test template so SubmitTemplate can
  build a valid Meta API payload

* fix: Resolve data race in async message send and queue test parallelism

- messages.go: Use Model(&Message{}).Where("id=?") instead of Model(msg)
  in finalizeMessageSend to avoid mutating the shared msg struct from the
  async goroutine while the caller reads it concurrently
- queue_test.go: Remove t.Parallel() from stream tests that share a
  single Redis stream, preventing cross-test interference

Message:
Fix API request body issues and update documentation (#45) (#47)

* fix: API request body issues (#45)

Issue 1: Fix foreign key constraint when using phone_number
- Find or create contact from phone_number instead of failing
- Remove dead code for phone-only send path

- Validate required parameters before sending to WhatsApp
- Return clear error message listing missing params

- Support buttons, lists, and CTA URLs
- Add InteractiveContent and ButtonContent structs

Also adds 11 unit tests for parameter extraction and resolution.

* docs: Update messages API documentation

- Add phone_number support for template messages (auto-creates contact)
- Document template_params with named and positional parameters
- Add interactive message documentation (buttons, CTA URLs)
- Include curl examples alongside JSON samples

- agent_transfers.go: role-based filtering
- template_engine.go: path character handling

* Fix IsActive field by using explicit update after create

GORM's Select() doesn't override database defaults for boolean fields.
Use a two-step approach: create with default, then update if false.
